ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory PEP and sanctions list screening for all shareholders, directors, legal representatives and ultimate beneficial owners. Screening against OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council Consolidated List, EU Consolidated Sanctions List, UIAF terrorist financing lists, and the Colombian National Registry of People and Entities ('Lista Clinton'). Enhanced due diligence for any PEP (foreign or domestic) and heightened risk-flagging where payment rails include Stripe or Wise. Compliance with UIAF guidance and FATF Recommendations 24 and 25.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES) and the online platform of the local Cámara de Comercio (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: All corporate names must be in Spanish or in Latin script with a Spanish explanation. Non-Spanish names must be transliterated into its phonetically appropriate Spanish equivalent; the name must be distinguishable from all other registrants, not misleading, and in accordance with the Código de Comercio Articles 94-95 and Regulatory Resolution 0008 of 2020 (or applicable chamber rules).
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the name reservation expires, reapply at the same Cámara de Comercio. Upon rejection, file a written 'recurso de reposición' before the Cámara de Comercio within 10 business days; if denied, file a 'recurso de apelación' before the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio within 10 business days. Alternatively, request a new distinct name through the RUES portal.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office address is generally acceptable for registration with the Cámara de Comercio, provided it is a specific physical address in Colombia and not a PO Box. However, commercial substance expectations for a virtual CFO services entity (ISIC 6920) require retention of local premises, local records, and actual personnel capacity sufficient to service clients, satisfy DIAN controls, and support bank account opening with Stripe/Wise.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low (estimated 5–10% annual probability) for a low-risk back-office services company; however, DIAN tax audits and Cámara de Comercio physical verification visits may increase if invoicing crosses borders or if the entity is classified as an FPFT (filtered permanent establishment risk).

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008 (Articles 1–5, 8–13, 17–22 and 30) as the primary S.A.S. statute; supplementary Código de Comercio (Decreto 410 de 1971) and Decreto 1074 de 2015 (RUES / single business portal regulation).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Superintendencia de Sociedades (oversight) and the local Cámara de Comercio (registry execution, e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá) operating the Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución (private articles of incorporation with duly authenticated signatures) filed through the Ventanilla Única Empresarial (VUE) and recorded in the Mercantile Registry (Registro Mercantil / RUES).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum legal capital under Law 1258/2008 for S.A.S. entities; subscribed capital may be fixed at a symbolic value (e.g., COP 1 per share) and paid-in capital may be deferred for up to two years. No statutory escrow or deposit certificate is required before registration; cash contributions are payable to the corporate account as stipulated in the bylaws.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST ORGANIZING BOARD RESOLUTION — [COMPANY NAME] S.A.S. (1) The subscriptions of 100 ordinary shares at COP 1,000 par value each, for a total subscribed capital of COP 100,000, are approved, and the payment terms contained in the bylaws are incorporated by reference. (2) The registered office is fixed in Bogotá D.C.; the corporate purposes, principal line (ISIC 6920), and company term are adopted as written in the incorporation document. (3) [LEGAL REPRESENTATIVE NAME] is appointed as sole legal representative and [DEPUTY NAME] as substitute, with authority to open bank accounts, execute service agreements, invoice, and represent the company before DIAN, Cámara de Comercio, and public authorities. (4) All pre-incorporation expenses and filings under Law 1258/2008 are ratified.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Name Availability Search and Reservation (Certificado de Homonimia)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio (local Chamber of Commerce) — Ventanilla Única Empresarial / RUES virtual portal.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the proposed company name(s) through the VUE online portal (www.vue.gov.co access via chamber site) or the chamber’s virtual office; the system automatically issues a certificate of non-coincidence (certificado de homonimia); pay the search fee online; a list of recommended alternatives will appear if the first choice is occupied; select the desired denomination and keep the certificate valid while the incorporation document is prepared.
required_dossiers: Proposed corporate name (up to three alternatives)
Applicant identification document (cédula de ciudadanía or passport)
Online payment receipt for name search fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected for similarity, the RUES system suggests alternative names; an applicant may re-file immediately without an additional fee within the same virtual session; if the certificate expires, re-submit before filing the incorporation document.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and Signature Authentication of the Private Incorporation Document
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public (Notaría) or Cámara de Comercio signature-recognition window.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Documento Privado de Constitución containing the mandatory clauses of Law 1258/2008 (identifications of shareholders, name, domicile, term, corporate purpose covering outsourced virtual CFO services under ISIC 6920, subscribed and paid-in capital, classes and number of shares, management body, and bylaws). If contributions include real property, formalize by Escritura Pública before a notary; otherwise authenticate the incorporators' signatures at a notary or at the chamber; stamp taxes and notarial fees are settled before filing.
required_dossiers: Valid identification documents of all shareholders
Proof of name availability certificate
Draft incorporation document and full bylaws
Capital subscription schedule detailing payment terms
Evidence of payment of municipal stamp taxes (if applicable)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the chamber declines to recognize signatures, convert the document to an Escritura Pública format before a notary; amend drafting defects and re-execute; the incorporation may also be signed digitally using approved electronic signatures.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Mercantile Registration of the Company and Statutory Books
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio — Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upload the authenticated incorporation document and the pre-registration form to the VUE, select the RUES tariff code, and pay the registry fee and Superintendencia de Sociedades contribution; after review, the S.A.S. acquires legal personality and the chamber issues the Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal; subsequently present the statutory corporate books (shareholder and board minute books, shareholder registry, and accounting book) for sealing and registration.
required_dossiers: Authenticated private incorporation document
RUES pre-registration form (Pre-RUT)
Receipt of payment of registration fees
Government-issued identification of the legal representative
Statutory books (Libro de Actas, Registro de Accionistas, Libro de Inventarios)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the chamber raises an inconsistency, correct the document and file an amendment within the 10-business-day legal correction window; if the registration is returned, resubmit with a cover letter addressing each observation; appeal adverse decisions to the Superintendencia de Sociedades.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Enrollment: NIT, RUT and Electronic Invoicing Authorization
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales) — Nueva Sede Electrónica.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Once the RUES registration is completed, the NIT is assigned automatically and must be confirmed on the final RUT (Registro Único Tributario) at the DIAN electronic portal; select the main economic activity (ISIC 6920) and the corresponding responsibility code for corporate income tax; enable electronic invoicing (facturación electrónica) by obtaining the digital signature certificate and requesting the validation environment through DIAN’s free software FACTURANDO or an authorized software provider (ASP); register the S.A.S. with the simplified payroll system (PILA) after appointing workers.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
Draft RUT form completed online
Identification data and digital signature of the legal representative
Registered office address and commercial activity codes
Company bank account details when invoicing is activated
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: File an online correction (solicitud de corrección) through the DIAN portal for any tax-status mismatch; schedule a virtual or branch service appointment at DIAN; if the e-invoicing resolution is delayed, request activation under the monthly DIAN conditions and continue using the provisional platform.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Beneficial Owner Declaration and Personal Data Controller Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DIAN (beneficial ownership) and Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio (SIC) for data protection.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Declare the ultimate beneficial owner(s) and economic structure using DIAN’s annual beneficial-owner reporting module in the RUT if there are shareholders resident abroad or layered structures; simultaneously register the company as a data controller in the SIC’s National Database Registry under Statutory Law 1581/2012, given that virtual CFO and bookkeeping services process client financial data; adopt a privacy notice consistent with Constitutional Court rulings and issue internal data processing policies.
required_dossiers: RUT confirmation with beneficial-owner annex
Ultimate beneficial owner identification and percentage of ownership
Privacy policy and data-processing manual
Authorization records (when processing occurs before formal consent is collected)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If data are inconsistent, re-file electronically in the SIC system or submit a correction request with DIAN; if a beneficial owner is incomplete, the society must comply with the entity’s transparency request and supplement the registry before the DIAN deadline to avoid evidentiary fines under Law 2155/2021.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Bank Account, Occupational Health (ARL/SGSST), and Payment-Rails Compliance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Supervised financial entities (banks / fintech), ARL administrators, and payment processors Stripe and Wise.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a corporate multi-currency account with an authorized bank or a qualified fintech; provide KYB documentation, including the registration certificate, shareholder register, and identification of signatories; affiliate the company and employees to an ARL and implement the SGSST program under Decreto 1072/2015; if a physical office is leased, obtain the Bomberos fire-safety certificate; submit KYB documentation to Stripe Billing and Wise, evidencing the registered domicile, beneficial owners, and lawful activity (fractional CFO advisory and virtual accounting), and link the DIAN-authorized invoicing system to the payment rails.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
Bylaws and shareholder register
Identification of directors and legal representative
Proof of registered address and anti-money-laundering ownership declaration
ARL affiliation receipt and SGSST workplace risk assessment (if applicable)
KYB forms of Stripe and Wise
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: On rejection by a financial institution, amend the KYB package per the compliance officer’s instructions and re-apply; if the ARL classification is disputed, request reclassification through the occupational risk management office within 30 days; for payment rails, provide a Spanish-language registration certification and, if needed, an English translation to satisfy foreign KYB reviews.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Junta Central de Contadores (JCC) — supervision of the certified public accountant in charge (Contador Público) — and Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio (SIC) — personal data controller registry. No industrial manufacturing authority applies to remote virtual CFO services.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: SIC National Database Registry for data controllers (Ley 1581/2012) and JCC-validated professional engagement of the company’s certified accountant, together with the DIAN electronic invoicing operation authorization.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio de Ambiente y Desarrollo Sostenible and the local Corporación Autónoma Regional (CAR) — consulted only if physical branches or IT infrastructure are later deployed.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt / Not required for pure virtual bookkeeping and CFO advisory: no physical EIA license is mandated for cloud-based service companies; an urban-environment exemption record may be requested from the local authority if a small administrative office is opened.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable to physical wastewater, VOC, or solid-waste discharges because operations are remote. Digital operations must still comply with Ley 1581/2012 data-protection standards and, when devices are deployed, with e-waste management policies under Law 1672/2013; any future office must register with the municipal public utility for sewer and solid-waste disposal.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: No structural-load inspection is required for a virtual-office model. For any leased physical office, obtain the Certificado de Bomberos (fire-safety clearance) and register occupancy with the local civil-defense authority; implement the occupational health and safety system (SGSST) under Decreto 1072/2015, affiliate staff to an ARL, and maintain the 12-month workplace-risk assessment and telework protocols (Ley 1221/2008) for remote employees.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) - official portal: www.dian.gov.co
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a foreign-owned S.A.S., the entity must first execute its incorporation deed before a notary and register the company with the local Chamber of Commerce (Cámara de Comercio). Subsequently, the legal representative (including a foreign resident denominator) must obtain an electronic signature certificate from a DIAN-certified certification authority. Through the DIAN website, the representative completes the RUT (Registro Único Tributario) application, automatically assigning the NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria). If the entity is liable for VAT or withholding, the corresponding tax registrations (IVA, ICA, etc.) are included in the RUT. Non-resident shareholders do not require a separate local TIN unless acting directly as taxable subjects; all registrations are executed in the name of the Colombian S.A.S.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Colombia does not offer US-style check-the-box elections. The principal available elections are: (1) opting into the Régimen Simple de Tributación (SIMPLE) for service entities meeting applicable UVT-based gross income thresholds, which consolidates income tax, VAT, and other levies; (2) applying group taxation (bases fiscales consolidadas) for economically integrated groups; and (3) electing between national accounting standards and full IFRS for mapping book-tax differences.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No general turnover threshold exists for local businesses performing taxable services; all VAT-responsible entities are obliged to register. For non-resident digital service suppliers, a registration threshold of approximately 200,000,000 COP annual sales applies, adjusted periodically by the DIAN.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory electronic invoicing (Facturación Electrónica) is required for all VAT-registered businesses. Invoices must be transmitted in real time in XML format via a DIAN-authorized provider or the DIAN’s free web/API platform. Each validated invoice receives a digital security stamp (CUDE). For exports, a special 'Factura de Exportación' must be issued. Full API integration with DIAN clearance is mandatory for all electronic invoice issuers.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods and services are zero-rated for VAT purposes. For services (including virtual CFO services), the service must be provided to a client domiciled abroad, definitively used/exploited outside Colombia, and the export transaction must comply with DIAN rules and exchange-control regulations. If these conditions are satisfied, the S.A.S. may invoice at 0% VAT and claim offsetting input VAT credits via periodic returns.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Declaración de Exportación (DEX) - customs export declaration
Bill of Lading (BL) or Airway Bill (AWB) for transport evidence
Inward Remittance Certificate - bank proof of FX repatriation
Factura de Exportación - commercial export invoice
Service contract or purchase order executed with the foreign client
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN may retroactively reverse zero-rating if export evidence is incomplete or fraudulent. Consequences include: surcharge of up to 200% of the VAT undercharged, default interest, administrative fines of up to 1,600 UVT per violation (Law 1819/2016), loss of input VAT credits previously recovered, and criminal prosecution for aggravated tax fraud. Failure to repatriate foreign exchange within 180 days triggers additional customs penalties.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República de Colombia (the Central Bank of Colombia), acting through its Departamento de Cambios Internacionales; the Colombian FX regime is codified in Decree 1068 of 2015 (Title 3, Single Regulatory Decree of the Finance and Public Credit Sector) and in Circular Reglamentaria DCIN-83, as amended. Day-to-day enforcement of tax and customs obligations associated with FX operations is supervised by the DIAN.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Colombian peso (COP) is freely convertible for both current-account and capital-account transactions, but every qualifying FX transaction must be channeled through the 'mercado cambiario', i.e., through an authorized intermediary (IMC) or a registered compensation account. Services exports (including virtual CFO and multicurrency bookkeeping services) are classified as current-account operations; profit remittances, capital contributions, and repatriation of capital are classified as capital-account operations. The principal practical hurdle is registration discipline: the foreign investment must be registered with the Banco de la República at the moment of channeling, and dividends or capital repatriations are not permitted to leave the country until such registration has been perfected and the corresponding exchange declarations have been filed.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Export proceeds arising from services rendered by the Colombian S.A.S. must be collected and channeled ('canalización') into Colombia through an authorized IMC within six (6) months from the completion of the service or issuance of the invoice, whichever is earlier. The full amount of proceeds is subject to the channeling obligation; although Colombia does not impose a fixed percentage-based forced conversion, the proceeds must be sold into the local market through the IMC or credited to an authorized compensation account. The IMC submits the relevant exchange declaration (Formulario de Declaración de Cambio por Exportación de Servicios) on each collection, and the exporter must retain the export contract, invoices, and proof of the effective collection for a five-year retention window.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Viability: Medium (conditional). Non-resident digital EMIs (e.g., Wise Business, Airwallex, Payoneer) are not licensed by the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (SFC) and may not lawfully collect funds from the Colombian public or operate as the local peso settlement account; only SFC-authorized entities, including authorized SEDPE payment entities under Decree 2555 of 2010 and Law 1735 of 2014, may perform deposit-taking-like payment services in Colombia. The EMI can nevertheless be used as a lawful receiving rail for foreign-currency export proceeds provided the account is treated as a compensation account and declared under the DCIN-83 regime, and provided all funds are repatriated into the Colombian FX market within the statutory six-month window. EMI balances must not be used to compensate Colombian payroll or local vendors because such arrangements would circumvent the mandatory channeling rules and Colombian withholding obligations.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote account opening is generally permissible for a Colombian S.A.S. whose legal representative is non-resident, provided the bank completes enhanced video-identity verification of the legal representative and the ultimate beneficial owner. In practice, tier-1 banks require at least one in-person or notarized signature registration, which can be achieved by a locally resident attorney-in-fact holding an apostilled power of attorney, or by the legal representative appearing physically at a branch. The mandatory document package includes the RUT, the certificate of existence and legal representation issued by the Chamber of Commerce (certificado de existencia y representación legal), the company bylaws, the shareholders register, and the SARLAFT/UBO questionnaire.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Single non-resident shareholder owning 100% of the S.A.S. with anticipated immediate cross-border profit distributions
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: UBO register and SAGRILAFT documentation, chamber-of-commerce certificate of existence and legal representation, audited financial statements, evidence of Colombian economic substance (payroll, leased office or co-working space, local client contracts), and a signed business plan demonstrating ongoing Colombian operations.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume multicurrency collections via third-party PSPs (Stripe Billing) with rapid payouts, flagged as a potential money-laundering or crowdfunding pattern
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Merchant agreements with the PSPs, monthly settlement reports, matching invoice and deliverable register, chargeback and refund ledger, treasury reconciliation policy using MT940 statements, and documented transaction monitoring under the SARLAFT framework.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Related-party management fees or intercompany commissions routed to individual foreign directors or offshore group entities
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Board minutes approving the transactions, signed intercompany service agreements, transfer pricing self-assessment and benchmarking study (Form 1126 filing, where applicable), withholding tax certificates, and proof of actual services rendered supported by time records and deliverable reports.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Attempts to withdraw cash or pay local suppliers in cash above the legal tax-deductibility threshold
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Board resolution prohibiting cash withdrawals, account instructions specifying wire-only disbursements, treasury manual, master service agreement payment terms, and a compliance training record demonstrating the anti-cash policy.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Foreign equity capital intended for the Colombian S.A.S. must enter exclusively through the Colombian FX market: (i) the non-resident shareholder sends the funds via SWIFT MT103 to the S.A.S.'s foreign-currency account or the correspondent Nostro account of a Colombian authorized intermediary (IMC); (ii) at the moment of conversion to COP, the IMC prepares and files the exchange declaration applicable to foreign investment (Formulario de Declaración de Cambio por Inversiones Internacionales), which simultaneously perfects the registration of the investment in the Banco de la República's foreign investment registry; (iii) the resulting COP balance is credited to the S.A.S. operational account; (iv) the S.A.S. must provide its tax identification number (NIT), the certificate of existence and legal representation, and a capital contribution resolution to support the channeling; (v) all subsequent capital repatriations and dividend remittances are contingent on this registration being valid and fully documented.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For the virtual CFO services scope, disbursements are predominantly service imports and direct operational payments. The compliant clearing rail is a SWIFT MT103 wire transfer initiated from the S.A.S.'s peso account, with the IMC purchasing the required foreign currency and filing the Formulario de Declaración de Cambio por Importación de Servicios against the underlying invoice and deliverable evidence. Colombian source withholding tax and VAT obligations must be settled before or simultaneously with the transfer, and corresponding certificates retained. Commercial documentary letters of credit are not standard for services; where a client requires contract performance assurance, a standby letter of credit or bank guarantee issued by a Colombian bank is the appropriate instrument. The S.A.S. may also use the clearing services of its IMC to route payments through SEPA, Fedwire, or other international rails in favor of offshore sub-contractors and SaaS vendors.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD/COP deliverable outright forwards contracted with authorized Colombian intermediaries (IMCs)
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) referenced to the Colombian official exchange-rate basket, when executed as bona fide hedges of real commercial exposure
Cross-currency swaps (CCS) for long-term USD-denominated trade payables or intercompany loans
European-style plain vanilla FX options and zero-cost collars limited to hedging projected service-export cash flows

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Commercial Registry Renewal (Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio (local Chamber of Commerce through RUES)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before 31 March (first three months of each calendar year)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal after 31 March accrues a late-filing fee and a non-compliance notation; persistent non-renewal can lead to administrative cancellation of the commercial registry and loss of legal capacity to invoke registered acts against third parties.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Final Beneficial Owner Annual Confirmation (Reporte de Beneficiarios Finales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio (RUES mandatory UBO form)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually with the commercial registry renewal, no later than 31 March
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Omission or false information constitutes an AML registral violation; sanctions may include fines imposed by Colombian AML authorities and refusal to issue the renewed registry certificate.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Approved at the ordinary shareholders' meeting held no later than 31 March and deposited with the Chamber within one month of approval
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to deposit audited or certified accounts may impede renewal, subject the company to fines, and constitute grounds for administrative sanction by the Superintendencia de Sociedades.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Statutory Auditor's Report (Dictamen del Revisor Fiscal) – if audit threshold triggered
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Delivered with the annual financial statements, no later than 31 March
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Missing statutory auditor opinion makes financial statements incomplete and prevents valid shareholder approval and commercial registry renewal.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Return (Declaración de Renta)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On the DIAN annual calendar assigned to the last digit of the NIT, generally April–June of the following fiscal year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing triggers an extemporaneity penalty (5% of the tax determined) plus default interest; continued non-filing allows DIAN official assessment and asset-seizure proceedings.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: An S.A.S. must appoint a revisor fiscal when total assets or gross income exceed 5,000 monthly legal minimum wages (SMMLV) at the prior year-end, or where required by the company's by-laws or the Superintendencia de Sociedades.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Colombian Law 1314/2009 technical accounting framework; IFRS (NIIF plenas) for large entities and IFRS for SMEs (NIIF para Pymes) for smaller entities, as adopted by the CTCP and DIAN-approved decrees.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The S.A.S. must file the RUES UBO declaration annually at commercial renewal, even with no ownership changes. Any share transfer creating a new direct or indirect final beneficiary (natural person with 25% or more ownership, voting/control rights, or ultimate control) must be recorded in the share ledger and reported in the UBO form before the annual confirmation window closes.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: US$300–US$1,200 per year for registered agent/office and local compliance support
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: US$2,500–US$8,000 per year if the revisor fiscal threshold is exceeded; no statutory audit cost below the threshold
